subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What Feishu card-action payload contract should OpenClaw expose for `form_value`, `input_value`, `option`, `options`, and `name` fields?
rationale: The fix belongs in the Feishu plugin and is small, but the JSON-versus-command text shape becomes agent-visible channel behavior and must preserve compatibility for existing button cards.

options.title: Refresh the structured passthrough PR
options.body: Review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953, preserving simple button commands while exposing form/input/select fields in a documented structured payload.

options.title: Ship form submissions first
options.body: Limit the first fix to `form_value` and leave selector/input payload shape to a follow-up if maintainers want a smaller compatibility surface.

options.title: Keep card actions command-only
options.body: Decline general passthrough and require richer Feishu forms to use a custom plugin callback route instead.

recommendation.title: Refresh the structured passthrough PR
recommendation.body: Review or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43953, preserving simple button commands while exposing form/input/select fields in a documented structured payload.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark community maintainer, and the choice is specific to the Feishu channel payload contract.
